description: A pre-seed fund and newsletter for AI-native startups across Africa. I co-founded it with Aisha Aliu. The newsletter reaches about 11,000 readers in 12 countries.
A voice-first AI health assistant for Nigeria. People call a number, describe their symptoms in their own language, and get advice and a referral to a nearby pharmacy, lab or clinic.
Operations software for UK housing providers and student accommodation operators. It covers housing stock, tenant allocation, rent collection, repairs and complaints in one place.

Growth Lab is a 12-week accelerator for Nigerian startups that already have a product and need to scale. It is part of iDICE, a programme backed by the Federal Government of Nigeria and the Bank of Industry. Selected startups receive $100,000, with up to $250,000 more at the end. I built the curriculum and speaker line-up and worked on selecting the first cohort.
A newsletter about technology across Africa with about 60,000 readers. I wrote long-form essays on cities, capital, AI and infrastructure.
A wearable for women's health. I led early commercial work.
A community fund that pays university entrance exam fees for students in Ibafo, where I grew up. It has supported more than 300 students.
